Retrieve a previously created response

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    response_id = "resp-abc123"
    result = await client.retrieve_response(response_id)
    print(result.id)
    print(result.status)

asyncio.run(main())
```
